post_clip.description: A dark-colored car enters the intersection from the bottom left and collides with a white van that is turning right (visible in frames 6–8). The impact causes the van to swerve sharply and the dark car to spin, indicating a clear road accident. This qualifies as an incident (road accident) under the specified anomaly types.

A person is seen lying on the road near the center of the intersection (visible across frames 1–10), appearing motionless or incapacitated after what appears to be a vehicle impact; a dark SUV approaches and passes very close to the person without stopping, suggesting a hit-and-run incident. This constitutes a road accident with potential assault/neglect, which qualifies as an abnormal and suspicious activity.

A white van collides with a white SUV at the intersection; the van appears to deliberately swerve into the SUV, causing it to spin and the van to tip onto its side—indicating a possible intentional vehicle collision (road incident/violence), not a typical accident given the abrupt maneuver and lack of evasive action from either vehicle.
